name: Bits
fullname: Bits: a binary counter, A to D and D to A
summary: Binary counter, analogue to digital and digital to analogue.
author: Animatek
about: The G2's BinCounter, ADConv and DAConv in one module, by a Mode button. Each mode makes a byte (0-255). Out is that byte as a level, and Bit 1-8 are its bits as logic signals. Eight LEDs show it.
Count: every rising edge of Clk adds one, and 255 goes back to 0. A>D: In (0 to +64 units) is turned into a byte in 256 steps. D>A: B1-B8 are read as bits, each one set when its input is above 0.
usage: Count from a clock and use the bits as divided clocks: Bit 1 runs at half the rate, Bit 2 at a quarter.
In A>D, feed a slow LFO to get its value as eight gates.
In D>A, build a stepped level from eight gates.
notes: Control rate. The counter keeps counting in every mode, so switching back finds it where it went.

patch_notes.bits.pch: ClkGen clocks the counter and an LFO feeds its input; the byte, Bit 1 and Bit 8 come out.
